title: Transport of an integration identity
statement: Let C,D,Cprime,Dprime be categories, F:C→D and Fprime:Cprime→Dprime functors, U:C→Cprime and V:D→Dprime, and beta:F⋙V→U⋙Fprime a natural transformation. Let S,L in C and T in D, with arrows a:T→F(S), delta:S→L, trace:F(L)→T whose composite a F(delta) trace is id_T. Given primed endpoints and arrows, source and line comparisons s:U(S)→Sprime, h:U(L)→Lprime, and an isomorphism e:V(T)≅Tprime, suppose the source, class and trace comparison squares commute. Then aprime Fprime(deltaprime) traceprime=id_Tprime.

source.place: paragraphs (1)--(2), transport of the two integration composites

proof.text: Precompose by e.hom. Substitute the source square, the class square, naturality of beta on delta, and the trace square. The composite is V applied to the original identity, followed by e.hom. Cancel e.hom.

theorem integration_transport
    {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} {C' : Type u₃} {D' : Type u₄}
    [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} D] [Category.{v₃} C'] [Category.{v₄} D']
    (F : C ⥤ D) (F' : C' ⥤ D') (U : C ⥤ C') (V : D ⥤ D')
    (mate : F ⋙ V ⟶ U ⋙ F')
    {S L : C} {T : D} {S' L' : C'} {T' : D'}
    (s : U.obj S ⟶ S') (line : U.obj L ⟶ L') (e : V.obj T ≅ T')
    (a : T ⟶ F.obj S) (delta : S ⟶ L) (trace : F.obj L ⟶ T)
    (a' : T' ⟶ F'.obj S') (delta' : S' ⟶ L') (trace' : F'.obj L' ⟶ T')
    (hsource : V.map a ≫ mate.app S ≫ F'.map s = e.hom ≫ a')
    (hdelta : U.map delta ≫ line = s ≫ delta')
    (htrace : V.map trace ≫ e.hom = mate.app L ≫ F'.map line ≫ trace')
    (h : a ≫ F.map delta ≫ trace = 𝟙 T) :
    a' ≫ F'.map delta' ≫ trace' = 𝟙 T'
